narrative: An employee inadvertently opens a malicious email attachment, leading to a multi-stage ransomware attack that encrypts critical company data and demands a ransom for decryption keys.

attack_stages.description: An attacker sends a phishing email to an employee with a malicious attachment disguised as an important document.
The employee opens the attachment, executing the malware that installs a ransomware payload on their workstation.
The ransomware scans the local network for shared drives and connected devices, spreading itself to other machines.
The ransomware begins encrypting files on affected systems, rendering critical data inaccessible.
Once encryption is complete, the ransomware displays a ransom note on the screens of infected systems, demanding payment for decryption.
